name: Geometry Dash Cataclysm

comments.author: LagWarrior87
comments.content: Just played Cataclysm and I'm still catching my breath! That's one tough game, but man, it feels so good after you finally make it through.

comments.content: Wow, Geometry Dash Cataclysm is insane! Got stuck on the third section for ages, but somehow I made it.

comments.author: SavageKatana89

comments.author: CosmicLeviathanXX
comments.content: Geometry Dash never fails to surprise! Just managed to get through Cataclysm without restarting once.

comments.author: AstroRevolver_X

comments.author: FlamingPotionX
comments.content: So tough, but Cataclysm is just one of those levels that gets me hyped every time I play it!

userInputText: Geometry Dash Cataclysm is an extremely challenging level with a rating of 10 stars and 3 user coins. It holds a special place in the Geometry Dash community and is considered the first episode of the Extreme Demons trilogy, which includes Bloodbath and aftermath.
